source.title: Shinners & Mahler's Illustrated Flora of North Central Texas
source.authors: Diggs, G. M. Jr.; Lipscomb, B. L.; O'Kennon, R. J.

morphology_documented.habit: Small to large tree, to 30 m or more
morphology_documented.leaves: Leaf blades divided about 0.5–0.6 of way to midrib
morphology_documented.fruit: Flora discusses typical shallow cup covering about 1/4 nut versus var. schneckii deeper rounded cup covering about 1/3
morphology_documented.habitat: Moist forests, especially stream bottoms and drainage ways

source_scope_note: Species, genus-key and secondary-source material separated; blank traits are not inferred from existing site data.
unresolved_taxonomy_or_source_notes: Hybridization and difficult identification versus Q. buckleyi documented in treatment of that species on printed p. 714
Flora subsumes schneckii but cites alternative varietal recognition; record historical disagreement
Oak wilt susceptibility noted but no management recommendation inferred
preservation: Additive research record only; originals, prior morphology, photos, source credits, galleries unchanged
